announcement.quote: today announced the Board of Trustees of Nuveen’s closed-end funds approved a series of mergers of single-state Nuveen municipal closed-end funds.

deals.notes: Acquired/acquiring pairing is read from the press-release table (Acquired Fund NPG and NZX, Acquiring Fund NKG) and the N-14 notice to shareholders of the three Georgia funds. Annual meeting adjourned to March 5, 2012, then to April 13, 2012, then to May 14, 2012 (425s of 2012-02-07, 2012-03-13, 2012-04-18); no outcome stated. The RW of 2012-07-06 withdraws a Form 8-A about preferred shares, not a merger registration.
